_comment: Bundle-size budgets in gzipped kB (REQUIREMENTS.md §13.5). Enforced by
`npm run budget`, which CI runs after the build — a regression fails the
build rather than being noticed later.
Groups are filename prefixes, not exact names: Vite fingerprints its output.
Raising a budget is fine when the growth is deliberate — do it in the same
commit as the change, so the increase is reviewed alongside what caused it.
_w1_note: assets/index went 110 -> 114 with W1.1-W1.5. The growth is the router
(ADR 0016), the eleven new shared primitives, the ~55-icon set (1.7 kB
gzipped of path data on its own) and the six empty-state illustrations.
Smaller than the sum of those because it is partly offset: the 204 duplicated
shell-CSS lines left every app stylesheet (F5), and the old bespoke table and
dialog CSS was replaced rather than added to.
